about_short_description.short_description: Paperspace powers next-generation applications built on GPUs.

product.name: CORE Virtual Servers
product.description: A fully-managed cloud GPU platform offering a variety of compute, storage, and networking options for GPU-accelerated workloads.

product.name: Gradient Machine Learning Platform
product.description: A platform to build, train, and deploy machine learning models of any size and complexity using hosted notebooks, workflows, and deployments.

product.name: Gradient Deployments
product.description: A service to deploy machine learning models as scalable API endpoints without managing infrastructure like Kubernetes or Docker.

product.name: Gradient Notebooks
product.description: Cloud-hosted Jupyter notebooks pre-configured with machine learning frameworks for developing and prototyping AI models.

product.name: Paperspace Machines
product.description: Cloud GPU-backed virtual machines available in various configurations for compute-intensive tasks like training and inference.

product.name: Cloud Desktops (VDI)
product.description: Virtual desktop infrastructure providing remote access to Windows or Linux desktops with GPU acceleration for various workloads.
